facts.D_choice: Without forcephase, target phase when enabled then saved phase then initial; best conflict-free trail is retained for target/best.
facts.phase_saving: Ordinary search assignments, including propagated values, update phases.saved; lucky phase search is explicitly excluded.
facts.scope: Two actual solver seeds are a bounded perturbation check, not independent input samples or proof of robustness to arbitrary input reordering.
facts.seed_can_change_search: D random rephase, walk and sweep use opts.seed; sweep also changes per invocation. Forcephase disables rephasing, but not every seed-dependent simplification.
facts.seed_does_not_default_shuffle: shuffle=0, randec=0, shufflerandom=0. Queue/score random seed calls require their disabled option gates.
